notes: Consumer-side animation specification for the Reimu Eating Set v1.
This file is NOT a Sprite Harness Animation Plan; tools/build_reimu_animations.py deterministically expands it into one legal plan per state and drives the public sprite-harness CLI.

Flattened single-image sprites (base.png) include the low table, food, and tatami. Whole-sprite motion moves the ground line and food with the character, so states without approved local motion remain a one-frame identity hold.

A state may use authored layers through source_mode=layered, or a pinned maintainer-approved external sequence through source_mode=exact_frames. Both paths are validated by Sprite Harness; consumer-only routing keys never reach the Animation Plan.

The confirmed task_2 chew-v9 exact sequence is pinned under pets/reimu/animations/eating/sources and is the production runtime source. Its approved neutral is the production task_2 fallback; chew-v7 remains pinned as legacy, and the preceding Eating Set v1 fallback is retained as base-eating-set-v1-legacy.png with provenance in legacy-assets.json. The layered reconstruction is not task_2 color truth.
